scope: Synthetic collection quality checks; no training or independent performance evaluation

checks.detail: Heuristics do not establish permission or absence of sensitive information

limitations: No human-approved data is inferred from AI checks.
Exact hashes detect byte duplicates; perceptual similarity requires visual review.
Sensitive-data heuristics require separate manual review.
Business material not provided is unconfirmed, not confirmed zero.

findings: 10 documents match case brand/product/discount/disclaimer/visual direction and remain explicitly synthetic with human review pending.
Direct four-document sample keeps production intention separate from observations and treats missing evidence as a package issue, not pixel error.
Rights/public/commercial permission is not implied by generation or AI review.
Changed ambiguity clause independently rechecked in all 10 documents: readable maximum-discount text with unclear product eligibility is semantic ambiguity, consistent with the three image cases.
independent_reviews.result: AI basic content checks passed; human approval pending

findings: Sample requested actions align with the five draft intent labels; status queries preserve retrieval rather than starting a new run.

Initial redundant condition-change requests were corrected to 24px minimum disclaimer height, before/after editing SHA-256, and exactly-one brand appearance; all 15 corrected sentences directly rechecked.
Intent-specific repeated insertion templates give strong classification clues; data is not representative of real requests or an independent performance benchmark.
independent_reviews.result: 71 distinct request samples semantically checked; all 250 labels remain human-unreviewed drafts

independent_reviews.method: Direct view_image inspection of 3-column/4-scenario contact sheet, plus full-size SYN-AD-01-normal PNG; compared with author observations and package evidence.
findings: Author observations align with visible brand, product, discount and development disclaimer across 12 images.
Ambiguous cases retain readable text but qualify discount as maximum and limit eligibility to some menu items; ambiguity concerns applicability, not OCR failure.
Controlled missing-evidence cases retain four visible criteria and add a seasonal banner; package evidence is deliberately omitted for three submissions while global production audit remains present.
Seasonal marketing claim is additional unreviewed content outside the four recorded text criteria; no whole-document compliance or rights approval is inferred.
Document ambiguity definition now includes unclear applicability; updated clause independently checked in all 10 documents.
independent_reviews.result: Independent AI visual observations consistent; all labels and rights remain human-unreviewed drafts
